# googleworkspace_role_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a Google Workspace admin role to a user or group via the Admin SDK Directory API.

Every attribute forces replacement, since the API has no update operation for role assignments. Look up built-in role IDs with the `googleworkspace_role` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "googleworkspace_role" "group_admin" {
  name = "_GROUPS_ADMIN_ROLE"
}

resource "googleworkspace_user" "admin" {
  primary_email = "group-admin@example.com"

  name {
    given_name  = "Grace"
    family_name = "Hopper"
  }
}

resource "googleworkspace_role_assignment" "group_admin" {
  role_id     = data.googleworkspace_role.group_admin.id
  assigned_to = googleworkspace_user.admin.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `assigned_to` (String)
- `role_id` (String)

### Optional

- `org_unit_id` (String)
- `scope_type` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the role assignment ID.
terraform import googleworkspace_role_assignment.group_admin 1234567890123456
```
